title: Adenta Ridge residential plots
summary: Serviced residential plots on a graded road, twelve minutes from the Adenta highway interchange.
description:
A compact release of eight residential plots on the Adenta ridge, laid out around a newly graded access road with drainage on both sides.

The land is registered, the site plan is approved, and each plot has concrete corner pillars. Electricity and water lines run along the access road, so a buyer can start building without waiting for the estate to be completed.

Plots are sold with the indenture, site plan and a company search report. A land officer walks every buyer through the boundary before reservation is confirmed.

title: Prampram coastal parcels
summary: Half-acre parcels in a quiet coastal settlement, twenty minutes from the new harbour corridor.
description:
Four half-acre parcels sit on gently level ground behind the coastal road at Prampram, with mature neem trees along the eastern boundary.

The land is held under a registered indenture and is being sold with a survey plan and boundary report. The access road is motorable throughout the year and the community has an established water supply.

This is a long-hold residential buy rather than an immediate build. Buyers who want to start within twelve months should ask the team about servicing timelines before reserving.

title: Kasoa Opeikuma serviced plots
summary: Entry-level residential plots in a built-up Kasoa neighbourhood with an active community.
description:
A small cluster of plots at Opeikuma, inside an established residential area rather than a new estate. The surrounding streets are built up and occupied, which makes this a practical first purchase for a buyer who wants neighbours and services already in place.

The plots are registered and come with a site plan. Access is from a public road, and the local assembly has completed drainage on the main approach.

Reservations are limited to one plot per buyer until the initial release is confirmed.

title: Aburi hillside estate land
summary: Elevated 1.2-acre parcel with mature trees and a long view over the Akuapem ridge.
description:
A single 1.2-acre parcel on the Aburi ridge, set back from the main road behind a line of mature trees. The ground falls gently to the west, which gives a building platform with a long view while keeping the approach level.

The parcel is registered, surveyed and sold with its site plan. A shared access easement runs along the northern boundary and is documented in the indenture.

This is a low-density residential purchase. The team can arrange a site walk with the surveyor before any reservation is confirmed.

title: Kumasi Asokore farmland
summary: Twelve acres of working farmland with rich soil, a seasonal stream and family-held customary title.
description:
Twelve acres of cultivated land at Asokore, currently used for maize and vegetables. The soil is deep and holds moisture well, and a seasonal stream crosses the lower boundary.

The land is held under customary title with the family’s written consent and a witnessed transfer record. It is suited to continued farming, agro-processing or a long-term land bank.

Because the title is customary, the company arranges a family meeting and documents the transfer before completion. Buyers should expect that process to take longer than a registered-title purchase.

title: Takoradi Airport City commercial land
summary: Corner commercial parcel on the Airport City spine road, cleared and ready for a mid-rise development.
description:
A cleared 0.8-acre corner parcel on the Airport City spine road in Takoradi, with frontage on two streets and a wide turning radius for service vehicles.

The land is registered and zoned for commercial use. Power is available at the boundary and the site has already been graded, which shortens early works for a hotel, office or mixed-use building.

Buyers should confirm their intended use with the assembly before reserving. The company provides the zoning letter and site plan on request.

title: Ho Bankoe mixed-use plot
summary: A 0.3-acre town plot in Ho with road frontage, suited to shops below and residences above.
description:
A town plot at Bankoe in Ho, with frontage on a tarred road and a short walk to the central market. The plot is level and already cleared.

It is held under an indenture and sold with a site plan. Mixed use is common on this street, with shops at ground level and homes above, which is the pattern the planning office expects.

This is a good fit for a buyer who wants a small commercial building with living space. The team can share the indenture and a boundary report before a site visit.

title: Tamale Vittin residential land
summary: Flat, registered residential land in a growing Tamale suburb with a new access road.
description:
A 0.4-acre residential plot at Vittin, on the eastern side of Tamale. The land is flat, well drained and sits on a new access road that connects to the main Vittin road.

The title is registered and the plot is sold with a site plan. Water is available from the community supply, and the electricity extension along the road is complete.

The area is still developing, so buyers should visit at different times of day and speak to neighbours before committing. Site visits can be arranged with a land officer.

title: Cape Coast Abura gated plots
summary: Plots inside a small gated layout at Abura, with a shared wall, gate and paved internal road.
description:
A limited release of plots inside a small gated layout at Abura, Cape Coast. The estate has a shared perimeter wall, a controlled gate and a paved internal road.

Each plot is registered and sold with a site plan. The shared infrastructure is already in place, so the reservation covers the plot and a defined share of the common areas.

The estate is managed by a residents’ association. Buyers receive the association’s current service charge and building guidelines before completion.

title: Akosombo lakeside retreat land
summary: Two and a half acres above the Volta lake, with a private approach and a protected view corridor.
description:
A 2.5-acre parcel on the hills above Akosombo, with a long view across the Volta lake and a private approach road shared by three properties.

The land is registered and surveyed. A building envelope has been marked to protect the view corridor, and the remaining slope is left in natural vegetation.

The parcel suits a private retreat or a small hospitality project. Buyers considering a commercial build should confirm the tourism zoning with the district assembly before reserving.
